info.title: Ambee Universal API
info.description: Access climate, air quality, pollen, weather, wildfire, disaster, geocoding, and elevation data from Ambee.

get.description: Retrieves location coordinates in Ambee by place name.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: place
parameters.description: Name of the location to search.

schema.description: Name of the location to search.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
